messages:
nina: Heads-up — bulk-invite job (bulk-217555) completed but several interviewers reported the scorecard attached was the wrong template (senior_backend vs senior_frontend). Noticed across two requisitions. Anyone seen this pattern?

lee: saw one flagged by an interviewer this morning. they said the competency sections didn't match the role.

omar: the bulk-invite script picks template by role_slug mapping. we recently added aliasing for 'backend' -> 'backend_engineer' which may have widened the match.

nina: here's the command used: `./scripts/bulk_invite --job bulk-217555 --include-scorecard`

recruit-bot: recruit-bot: bulk-invite job bulk-217555 finished. 142 invites sent, 7 warnings. warning_codes=[template_mismatch_role_alias]

lee: could be a mapping precedence bug. if alias resolution checks aliases before exact role it may pick backend_engineer.alias -> senior_backend template incorrectly.

omar: I'll grep the invite code. suspect area: templates.get_for_role(role_slug, allow_aliases=True). we should prefer exact matches, fallback to aliases.

nina: can we diff templates for the affected invites? recruiter_id: 9987 and 9989 reported.

omar: pulling log for invite ids... looks like for req-552 and req-553 the role_slug in DB is 'backend' (legacy), while new hiring-ui sends 'backend_engineer'. alias resolution matched 'backend' -> 'backend_engineer' and chose the senior_backend template.

lee: immediate mitigation: re-send scorecard-only patch to affected interviewers with the correct template. I can run a targeted resend.

recruit-bot: recruit-bot: enqueue resend job resend-217555-1 for 7 affected invites by nina at 2026-04-12T14:02:00Z

nina: please also add a validation to the bulk-invite dry-run: assert that template selected matches role_slug exactly or warn loudly. the dry-run should print a sample pairing for review.

omar: agreed. I'll push a small change: prefer exact role_slug match; add `--strict-template` flag to CLI for bulk runs. PR queued: recruiting-infra#243.

lee: for training: update interviewer onboarding note that if a scorecard looks off, report to #hiring-ops immediately and include the invite id. that helped triage this one fast.

nina: and let's add a short regression test in CI that runs bulk_invite dry-run against both legacy and new slugs. would catch future alias regressions.

omar: will add unit tests and a note in the release changelog.

recruit-bot: recruit-bot: resend-217555-1 started. estimated 10 minutes.

nina: thanks all, looping back once resends confirm.
